title: NCSOFT anti-cheat was unable to verify Aion 2
desc: Fix verification errors, file integrity checks and when to use Account Recovery after anti-cheat issues.

body.text: “NCSOFT anti-cheat was unable to verify your installation” blocks Aion 2 launch—not always a ban. File corruption, stuck anti-cheat modules, or conflicting software cause most cases.
What the error means
“NCSOFT anti-cheat was unable to verify your installation” blocks Aion 2 launch—not always a ban. File corruption, stuck anti-cheat modules, or conflicting software cause most cases.
Work through verification fixes before assuming HWID enforcement or buying [HWID Spoofer](/products/aion-2-cheats/hwid-spoofer/).
Verify game files on NCSOFT
Aion 2 launcher → Library → Aion 2 → Properties → Installed Files → Verify integrity. Let the scan finish completely.
Restart NCSOFT as administrator once. Retry launch before any cheat loader runs—vanilla pass confirms client health.
Restart anti-cheat and PC cold boot
Exit NCSOFT fully—including tray icon. Cold reboot (full power off, not fast restart). Relaunch NCSOFT, wait for cloud sync, then Aion 2.
anti-cheat modules sometimes stick after Windows sleep—cold boot clears stuck modules without reinstall.
Remove conflicting software
Disable overlay injectors, old cheat remnants, and kernel debug tools temporarily. Uninstall unused VPN kernel drivers.
Run Aion 2 vanilla once to confirm anti-cheat passes—then follow [external cheat guide](/blog/aion-2-external-cheat-guide/) for clean loader order.
When it is an actual ban
Persistent verify failure on every account after clean reinstall may indicate account restriction. Check NCSOFT profile ban status.
[Account Recovery](/products/aion-2-cheats/ugc/) helps structured appeal workflows—not instant unban guarantees. HWID spoof does not fix verify errors from corrupt files.
Loader order after fix
Once Aion 2 launches clean, read [anti-cheat patch day checklist](/blog/anticheat-patch-day-checklist/) before enabling [private aion 2 cheats](/products/aion-2-cheats/).
Launch external loader before Aion 2 per portal guide—reversed order can re-trigger verify on some builds.
After fix: safe return to cheats
Discord support wants verify-error screenshots plus order email if loader fails post-fix. Do not rage-queue Abyss same hour as verify fix—run private instance ESP check first.
Conservative presets after any anti-cheat-related error—telemetry spikes after client repairs.
